reviews.comment: Super fresh vine tomatoes delivered straight from Uttan farm within 4 hours!
The tomatoes were picked fresh this morning! Unbelievable sweetness compared to what we get at roadside mandis.
Chena Creek spinach was completely crisp with zero yellow leaves or grit. Steamed it directly, tastes phenomenal.
Authentic Vasai Rajeli bananas! Naturally tree-ripened with unmistakable fragrance. 100% recommending Farm2Home to neighbours in Beverly Park.
